Texas real estate disclosures

Required notices, in one place.

Texas asks real estate license holders to share a few notices. Here they are, along with who we are and how we are licensed.

Official Texas notices

Please read these first.

Who we are

Licensed in Texas.

Dillon Loren is a licensed Texas Realtor with Tradition Realty Group at Keller Williams Memorial. Texas real estate license number 681837.

Real estate services are provided through Keller Williams Memorial, 1220 Augusta Drive, Suite 300, Houston, Texas 77057, (713) 461 9393. Each Keller Williams office is independently owned and operated.

Dillon on Keller WilliamsKeller Williams Memorial

Fair housing

We support the Fair Housing Act and equal housing opportunity for everyone. Equal Housing Opportunity.

About our content

Opinions, not advice.

Tradition Local is community media. Our reviews, neighborhood guides, and videos are our own opinions and are meant for general information. They are not legal, financial, or real estate advice.

Prices, schools, and other details change, so please check anything that matters to you before you decide. We do not show property listings on this site.

If a place has a relationship with us, we say so in the review. You can read more in How we review places.

Questions about these notices?

Send us a note, and we will point you in the right direction.

Contact us

If you contact Dillon about real estate

If you reach out about buying, selling, or renting, Dillon may also keep your information as part of his real estate work with Keller Williams Memorial. That work is covered by the brokerage privacy policy, which you can read on the Keller Williams Memorial website.

Children

This site is not meant for children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their information.

Changes

If we change this page, we will update the date at the top.

Questions about your information?
